operation: forward sparse convolution; submanifold coordinate fixtures
output_layout: TILE_LAYOUT, device DRAM, original output row order
timing: host wall time including all required device operations and synchronization; excludes compilation, initial input upload, output download and static preparation
score: per-case median completed-operator latency; geometric mean for synthetic coverage only; application score requires measured occurrence counts
workspace_scope: temporary tensors beyond resident input, output, weights and topology; estimates must be labeled, allocator snapshots are not peaks
promotion: all selected correctness gates pass, evaluator/corpus hashes unchanged, and paired timing improvement exceeds measured baseline noise
known_failure_policy: report numerical_failure; never convert xfail into a pass or exclude it silently
